facts.text: Northwood University guides its educational philosophy through The Northwood Idea, emphasizing an entrepreneurial, free enterprise society and personal freedom.

sources.title: The Northwood Idea - Northwood University
sources.quote: We are unified by an unwavering belief in the advantages of an entrepreneurial, free enterprise society, personal freedom, and individual responsibility, functioning from a foundation of ethics and integrity and promoting and leveraging the global and multi-cultural nature of enterprise.
